  PERMITS AND LICENSES COMMITTEE
  MINUTES
  June 13, 2024

A meeting of the Permits and License Committee was conducted as a Call-In at 1-669-900-6833, meeting
ID 985 1970 8884 and Password 514315 on June 13, 2024 at 2:00 pm.

Roll Call:  Members Present:  Harjinder Singh, Administration
  Christine Rivera, Planning Department
  Cpt.Reggie Johnson, Los Angeles County Fire Department
  Sgt. Luis Jaramillo, Inglewood Police Department
  Raul Fernandez, Public Works Department
  Emory Ward, Emergency Service & Public Safety Department

  Angela Allen, City Clerk’s Office
  Staff Present:  Shalanda Stringer, Finance Department
  Ruben Rodriguez, Finance department

Public Comments Regarding Agenda Items
During public comments any person may address the Permits & License Committee, provided the item is
within the subject matter jurisdiction of the Permits & License Committee.

Chairman Singh asked if there were any persons present who wished to address the Permits & License
Committee on any item on the Agenda.

Chairman Singh reported that there were no public requests to speak.

Approval of the minutes of the meeting held on May 23, 2024

Permit(s):
Item #1:  Anthony Harris on behalf of City of Inglewood to host a Dodgers Day Event at 700 Warrren
  Ln., Edward Vicent Jr. Park, Public Property, on Saturday, July 13, 2024 from 10:00 a.m.
  – 12:30 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS: Applicant to adhere to recommendations outlined by the Planning
  Department / Inglewood Police Department; Approval for 1 day event at 700 Warren Ln.,
  Edward Vincent Jr. Park; applicant to hire two ( 2) police officers; two City Hall Security
  Officers; a watch commander will be notified and extra patrol-high visibility will be provided
  as time permits." Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at
  the end of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384687)
 Permits & License Committee  June 13, 2024
Minutes  Page 2 of 4

Item #2:  Kerri Arroyo on behalf of Inglewood Public Library to host a Gather Blast Foam Party/
  Lavapalooza Event at One W. Manchester Blvd.,City Hall North Lawn, Public Property, on
  Saturday, July 20 ,2024, from 1:00 p.m. – 3:00 p.m. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY
  SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approval for 1 day event at one
  Manchester Blvd; City Hall North Lawn; City Hall Security Guards will be staffed; A watch
  commander will be notified and extra patrol-high visibility will be provided as time
  permits;Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end
  of the event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social
  distancing, protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth
  by the LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 0038465)

Item #3:  Nilam Patel DBA Tomato Market to host a Tacos al Carbon Event at 10400 s. Prairie Ave,
  corner of Prairie Ave and 104th Street, Private Property , on Thursday, August 15, 2024
  through Sunday, August 18, 2024 from 4:00 p.m. – 12:00 a.m. APPROVED
  CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING STIPULATIONS: Approved:
  Applicant shall not impede any pedestrian or vehicular traffic. Applicant to hire professional
  / licensed security guard for the safety of guests & employees; NO use of public streets,
  sidewalks or alleys; Subject to Code Enforcement approval. Watch commander will be
  notified and extra patrol provided as time permits. Adhere to all local, state and federal
  laws; the four (4) event dates conclude the MAX number of events for the calendar year;
  Maintain site at all times, ensuring site is properly cleaned immediately at the end of the
  event; Applicant and staff members working this event shall follow all social distancing,
  protective personal hygiene and face mask wearing safety guidelines set forth by the
  LA.CO. Health Department and CA State health department; and Adhere to all State,
  Federal, LA County, and applicable Inglewood Municipal Code rules and regulations,
  including noise and signage. Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384555)
New Business License Request (s):

Item #4:  Peter Burke DBA Travellers Autobarn Inc. to operate as an Auto Rent /Lease at 500 W.
  Florence Ave. APPROVED CONDITIONALLY SUBJECT TO THE FOLLOWING
  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed
  license for more than six months will negatively impact your license renewal;All vehicles
  must be registered with DMV; NO parking of any vehicles, vehicle repairs / maintenance
  on any city streets, sidewalks or alleys; Ensure safe pedestrian and vehicular circulation on/off
  site at all times;Business owner and all employees shall have a valid and current
  government-issued identification in their possession at all times; Subject to random
  inspections by any City of Inglewood Code Enforcement or Police Officer or DMV
  Investigators at any time to ensure compliance; andAdhere to all State, Federal and
  applicable Inglewood Municipal Code (IMC) rules and regulations, including noise and
  signage.Failure to comply with any of the aforementioned will result in the revocation
  of your business license and any future business license application requests..
  Motion carried unanimously (Activity No. 00384613)
 Permits & License Committee  June 13, 2024

  STIPULATIONS:Payment of annual business license and tax fees, an expired or lapsed

  comply with any of the aforementioned will result in revocation of your business
  license and any future license application requests. Motion carried unanimously
  (Activity No. 00384602)
